name: RC-B10-0345/2026/REV1 – Recital E – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the ongoing persecution of Christians in Nigeria, notably the Kawel village massacre
part_text: E.whereas Christians are reported to be the most persecuted religious group globally, and the failure to address this persecution undermines the credibility of international efforts to protect freedom of religion or belief;
